test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Advanced Full Test - 02
subject: general
question:
This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.

(Left) 534 945 317 354 781 (Right)

(Example: 697 - first digit = 6, second digit = 9, third digit = 7)

NOTE: All operations to be done from left to right.

If all the numbers are arranged in ascending order, the position of how many numbers will remain unchanged?
solution:
Given: (left) 534 945 317 354 781 (right)

To find the number of positions that remain unchanged when the numbers are arranged in ascending order:

Original order: 534, 945, 317, 354, 781

Numbers arranged in ascending order: 317, 354, 534, 781, 945

None of the numbers remain in their original positions.

The correct answer is "Option 2".
